scoring_justification: Full recompute of the Debye-Callaway integral from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; the checker performs result-level comparison of the reported thermal conductivity values against the paper's Table 1 with a relative tolerance of 0.2, which is considered appropriate for a code-verifiable reproduction task involving a DFT-based workflow.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values of lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K for six systems from Table 1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: J. Mater. Chem. C, 2019, DOI: 10.1039/c9tc04023d, Table 1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's Table 1 (κ₁ column), units W m⁻¹ K⁻¹. The Ba8Ge43□3 entry is excluded because the model fails.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the published reference target for this reproduction task; they are the authoritative result the agent is expected to reproduce within tolerance.

schema.description: CSV file with two columns: system (string) and kappa_300 (float, W/m/K). Rows in exact order: Si46, Na8Si46, K8Si46, Ba8Si46, Ge46, K8Ge44□2, Ba8Ge43□3. For Ba8Ge43□3 the entry must be empty or the string 'N/A'.

outputs.description: Lattice thermal conductivity at 300K computed from DFT phonon properties and Debye-Callaway model.

output_contract.notes: The thermal conductivity for Ba8Ge43□3 is not computable with this model (divergent Grüneisen parameters); the agent should report an empty/N/A entry for that system.

steps.description: Check the six computable systems' thermal conductivity against paper gold with 20% relative tolerance.
Verify that the Ba8Ge43□3 row has an empty or N/A entry for kappa_300.
